overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Long MSTR Daily ETF (MSTP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of MicroStrategy stock. MSTP was launched on Jun 9, 2025 and is issued by GraniteShares.
